value.rationale: A nonergodic dynamical measure makes ordinary mixing inapplicable, while conditional mixing to a geometrically natural factor is meaningful. This result computes every sharp operator norm, the complete extremal Fourier family, and its Fibonacci double-exponential law across all quaternionic Nielsen lifts; it is not only a qualitative consequence of invariant-torus mixing.
